title: 第14章 请您救救他
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
一直未曾开口的陈家当家人陈建业甚至激动的站了起来，衰弱的身体差点倒了下去，好在身侧身体还算健朗的宋正阳快速的扶住了他。

    “郁神医，可以请您帮帮我吗？”陈建业急切的说着，“我不求自己的命有多长，我只求求您能救救我的孩子，即使是让我付出一切。”

    听到这个，了解陈家内情的三个老人想到了陈家一脉单传，陈建业唯一的儿子陈子轩在前段时间出了事，因为一些特殊原因，外面的人并没有听到风声，可他们几个老朋友还是清楚的。

    陈子轩的情况可不单单只是简单的生病，他是手脚皆被砍断，双目被挖，面部被毁，甚至连舌头也被人割了，而且身体内还有不知名的病毒，现在已经完全失去了意识，显然这个曾经被陈家自豪的英雄就这样被废了。

    陈子轩目前躺在海市军区医院，还是上面怜惜陈家唯一的孩子出事，才将人转了过来。

    陈建业听到郁凡这神奇的医术，便萌生了让他看看自己孩子的想法，就算不能将人恢复如常，可还是希望儿子能够醒过来。

    “郁神医，如果可以，请您帮帮老陈吧。”王德佑想到那个孩子，他可是他们这几个老家伙的后代里最有出息的一个了。

    年纪轻轻便成了少将，这一次若不是因为任务紧急，上面也不会将他派出去。

    看到四个老人恳求的眼神，想来那个他们想要救的人一定很重要。

    郁凡有种预感，救了这个人，能触及到顶层人物。

    他点了点头，表示自己应下了。

    或许是因为郁凡答应去看看，另外两个人虽然有些想法但也没有多说什么。

    虽然他们都想让郁凡给他们看看，可那个孩子更加紧急，而他们这些老不死的虽然年纪大了，可毕竟还能支撑住。

    看着包间里沉重的氛围，王德佑笑着给三个老人介绍了一下郁凡的孩子们，并着重介绍了郁嘉庆，言辞里不乏夸赞。

    几个老头子一听便明白了郁嘉庆必然是郁凡着重培养的对象，才引来王德佑的夸奖，不然这老家伙什么人才没见过。

    一个个便和郁嘉庆主动交谈了起来。

    郁嘉庆没想到自己会有这么受大佬欢迎的一天，虽然是因为自己父亲的原因，却也不由有些受宠若惊。

    在几个人互相配合下，一群人都交谈甚欢，一番了解后，饭也吃得差不多了，四个老人没敢再主动接近郁凡，而是和郁嘉庆交换了联系方式。

    正准备离开时，酒店总经理范成已经在外面恭候多时了。
content_en:
Chen Jianye, the head of the Chen family who had never spoken, even stood up excitedly. His weak body almost fell down. Fortunately, Song Zhengyang, who was still healthy at his side, quickly supported him.

"Doctor Yu, can you please help me?" Chen Jianye said eagerly, "I don't ask for how long my life will be. I just ask that you save my child, even if it costs me everything."

Hearing this, the three old people who knew the inside story of the Chen family thought of the fact that Chen Jianye's only son, Chen Zixuan, had an accident some time ago. Due to some special reasons, no one outside heard the news, but their old friends still knew about it.

Chen Zixuan's condition is not just a simple illness. His hands and feet were cut off, his eyes were gouged, his face was destroyed, and even his tongue was cut off. There was also an unknown virus in his body. He has now completely lost consciousness. Obviously, this hero who was once proud of the Chen family has been crippled.

Chen Zixuan is currently lying in the Haicheng Military Region Hospital. The superiors took pity on the Chen family's only child and transferred him.

When Chen Jianye heard Yu Fan's miraculous medical skills, he came up with the idea of ​​letting him see his child. Even if he couldn't restore the person to normal, he still hoped that his son could wake up.

"Doctor Yu, if you can, please help Lao Chen." Wang Deyou thought of that child. He was the most promising among the descendants of these old guys.

He became a major general at a young age. If it were not for the urgent mission, the superiors would not send him out this time.

Seeing the pleading eyes of the four old men, I thought that the person they wanted to save must be very important.

Yu Fan had a hunch that saving this person would help him reach the top people.

He nodded, indicating that he agreed.

Perhaps because Yu Fan agreed to go take a look, the other two people had some ideas but didn't say much.

Although they all wanted Yu Fan to show them, the child was more urgent, and although they, the immortals, were older, they could still hold on.

Seeing the heavy atmosphere in the private room, Wang Deyou smiled and introduced Yu Fan's children to the three old people, and introduced Yu Jiaqing with emphasis, with many compliments in his words.

Upon hearing this, several old men understood that Yu Jiaqing must be the one Yu Fan focused on cultivating, which was why Wang Deyou praised him. Otherwise, this old guy would never have seen anyone.

One by one, they started talking to Yu Jiaqing.

Yu Jiaqing didn't expect that he would be so popular with the boss. Although it was because of his father, he couldn't help but feel flattered.

With the cooperation of several people, the group of people chatted happily. After getting to know each other, the meal was almost finished. The four old people did not dare to approach Yu Fan anymore, but exchanged contact information with Yu Jiaqing.

When he was about to leave, the hotel general manager Fan Cheng had been waiting outside for a long time.
